hypothesis_of_change: Freeze the current source-linked atomic information plan as the search incumbent.
expected_benefit: Provides an auditable baseline for paired candidate comparisons.
possible_side_effects: The incumbent may still miss event evidence that static filings and financial facts cannot supply.
falsification_test: Reject the baseline as sufficient if a bounded event-evidence candidate improves paired admission utility without violating cost or coverage gates.

data_source_specs.retrieval_rule: Reuse complete SEC filing bodies already archived for the case cutoff.
Reuse bounded historical company-news summaries with publication dates and URLs.

contrastive_discovery_prompt.template: Compare labeled discovery cases only. Propose source-linked information requirements and signal candidates that distinguish surge cases from matched controls. Preserve counterexamples and other_or_unclassified facts.

seed_signal_specs.name: Event status and materiality
seed_signal_specs.hypothesis: Confirmed company-level events with source-backed status, timing, and materiality are more useful than generic catalyst mentions.
seed_signal_specs.observation_cutoff_rule: all supporting sources available by prediction_time
seed_signal_specs.extraction_rule: Extract subject, event, status, date, amount, unit, and source span; reject plans, invitations, and hypothetical risk language.
seed_signal_specs.contradictory_evidence_rule: Preserve delays, termination, dilution, default, and weak issuer relevance.

signal_merge_prompt.template: Merge discovery signals using source traceability, counterexamples, confounders, and complexity limits. Do not use admission outcomes.

blind_analysis_prompt.template: Use only the anonymous point-in-time packet. Estimate the probability of a three-month surge, cite supplied evidence refs, preserve contradictions, and abstain when critical information is missing.
